name: Kohinata Mamoru
source: Mamoru is a guy, who received the sacred extraterrestrial artefact in his body when he was a kid. So it's not surprising, that the aliens descended to Earth to take it back. The Sacred Orb can be extracted from his body through sex only, and the aliens are beautiful alien princesses, that looks exactly like women from Earth, so a wonderful adventures await this guy in the future.
